text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond's debut race drew great 
attention, dubbed the '500-Million-Point 
Showdown.'

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"RKST Points" evaluate pre-debut 
Umamusume. The upcoming race has gathered 
Umamusume with particularly high point 
totals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Saying she was used to the spotlight, 
Satono Diamond headed to her debut race 
without a hint of nervousness!
